Applied only from a book through an anvil. Evolves compatible vanilla and modded weapons, tools, and armor through World Tier III. Equipment keeps normal durability, Mending, and Unbreaking, but cannot be lost to fire, despawn, or the void. Tier III to IV and IV to V add no further power.
Based on enchantment level, has a chance to deal multiplied damage
Based on enchantment level, has a chance to deal area damage
Heals additional health when eating food
Allows Ghostly Essense to drop from any mob when killed!

Increases pellets fired by Shotguns but gets a longer cooldown.

A neutral mob found in Forests and Jungles. If approached slowly, it can be tamed with honeycombs. Once tamed, it can use a barrel from which it will eat at low health.
A neutral mob found in Jungles alongside its nests. Attacks illagers, villagers, and players on sight. Petrified fruit buried in its nests may yield exotic seeds when pecked by it.
A neutral mob found in Swamps and rarely in Deserts. It always spawns near water and stores items from entities it kills in its stomach. They can be retrieved with a feather.
A passive mob found in the forests that is easily scared by predators, players and loud noises. It is really fast and it can jump two blocks easily.
A neutral mob found on mountain peaks alongside its nests. While it is a baby, it can be tamed using raw chicken.
A neutral mob found in Savannas, with a rare variant in Snowy Plains. If approached slowly, it can be tamed with large amounts of meat. It will maul its prey.
An aquatic neutral mob found in Oceans. Attacks any entity with low health. It is attracted to conduits.
A neutral mob found in the overworld. Distract it with music to tame it using raw rabbit. Once tamed, it can sit on the owner's neck and assist in combat.
A neutral mob found in Frozen Oceans and shores that can be tamed by riding. When mounted, it can perform a whirlwind attack in water and a slam on land.
Devourer Tunnel Segment Ore Gen Dummy
An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Deep Waters. Can be fed shiny items to be granted with Night Vision. Deflates on Land. Fits in a bucket.

A neutral mob found in Anthills. It brings resources to its home and helps decompose blocks. When hatched from an Ant Pupa it follows and protects its owner, also attacking other ants with different colored Abdomens.
An underwater entity that explodes when collided with.
An aquatic neutral mob found in Warmer Oceans that only attacks players in water. Shoots exploding Barbs.
An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in deep Lukewarm and Warm Oceans. Can be caught in a Casting Net.
A really skittish aquatic ambient passive mob found in Tide Pools. Fits in a Bucket.
An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in Oceans and Cold Oceans. Can be thrown into a feeding frenzy if mobs nearby are hurt. Fits in a Bucket.
A two-passenger vehicle for traversing rivers and oceans.
A passive mob found on Sandy Islands that performs mating dances and mates for life.
A single-passenger vehicle that has its own storage.
An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans and Beaches. Can be collected by hand and with a Casting Net.
A neutral mob found in coastal regions that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket.
A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
A passive defenseless mob found on Dodo islands that shoots harmless seeds at hostile mobs. It's incapable of breeding and swimming and oblivious to danger.
A hostile mob made of molten rock and sunstone that can attack from long and close range.
A passive mob found in Mushroom Fields that can be milked for soup using a bowl. Transforms when struck by lightning.
A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.

A passive mob found in open grassy areas that can be tamed with Sunflower Seeds. It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.
An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans schooling in big groups. Fits in a Bucket.
A passive mob found on Tropical Islands that can absorb sunrays and use them to cook items. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
A passive mob found on sea stacks. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
A melon seed spat out at a high velocity. It's too small to deal meaningful damage.
An aquatic ambient mob rarely found in oceans. Can be captured in a multitude of items, including Casting Nets.
An aquatic ambient passive mob found circling bigger mobs. Fits in a Bucket.

A passive mob found in Seagrass Meadows that can be milked using a bucket. Grows Seagrass on its back and eats Tall Seagrass, occasionally finding Loot in it if fed before. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up. Drops leather.
An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Reefs and Seagrass Meadows. Comes in many shapes, sizes and colors based on where its found. Fits into a Bucket.
A passive mob found on Cold islands and in Frozen Oceans. Can hitch you a ride at the cost of live fish. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up.
A passive mob found in forests that produces Mucus when wet. It has a shell that can be knocked off with Projectiles and retreated into for protection.
A clump of salt shot at a high velocity.
An aquatic hostile mob that spawns in Cold Oceans and can jump, climb walls and shoot frozen bubbles.
A common crafting material made from Planks.
An ambient passive mob that attacks hostiles that bump into it. Can be turned on and off by waxing.
An aquatic ambient passive mob that can be found in Oceans. It basks during the day and swims near the bottom at night. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when fully grown up.
An aquatic passive mob that can be bred. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when grown up.
A squishy small egg that grows into a baby Tuna eventually.
Reduces the effectiveness of the armor on the target
Increases the damage dealt per block fallen
Emits a burst of wind upon executing a mace smash attack on an entity
